changes_from_v4: C-R1: strengthen GC-R3 so reuse-or-replace of an existing provider, library, storage engine, protocol, or architecture component is an agent investigation outcome and never a user-facing question for a novice; the agent resolves it from repository evidence or records an investigation/stop condition

C-R2: add the GC-R5 output-economy rule to workflow C5 (shortest domain-accurate typed items; lens label and rationale once per item not per turn; no restatement of resolved FACT/DECISION items), response-contract shape unchanged so the frozen output schema still applies

multi-seed sampling: threshold subset (9 ambiguous and high-risk tasks) x 5 seeds s1-s5; domain-language-conflict (3 tasks) x 3 seeds s1-s3; clear-local-reversible (6 tasks) x 1 seed s1; 180 trials across A, B, and C5

version-string reprint only: manifest.json, rubric.json, model-output.schema.json, judge-output.schema.json, and trial-result.schema.json restamped to wp5-v5 in their protocol_version/const fields (hashes differ from v4 by exactly the version string); trial-result.schema.json also widens its workflow enum from [A, B, C] to [A, B, C5, C5p] so v5 trial records validate; no other schema semantics change
freeze the C5p contingency arm (C-R1 only, v4 verbosity retained, no C-R2) before any subject output, even though it may never run

execution_policy.c5p_contingency: frozen in workflows/C5p.md; run on the threshold subset only if C5 regresses on an assumption, turn, or interruption metric relative to v4 C
